title: BidKV: Utility-Guided Preemption Scheduling for KV-Pressure LLM Serving
title_zh: BidKV：面向 KV 压力场景的效用引导抢占调度
affiliation: Huazhong University of Science and Technology (HUST)
venue: SC26: International Conference for High Performance Computing, Networking, Storage and Analysis
venue_full_zh: SC26 国际高性能计算、网络、存储与分析会议
abstract: When KV-cache demand exceeds GPU memory capacity during online LLM serving, serving engines reclaim cache from active requests to admit waiting ones. Poor victim selection wastes recomputation, delays admission of queued requests, and degrades first-token latency—a metric directly visible to users. Existing policies rely on coarse request-order heuristics (LIFO, FCFS) or independent per-request scoring rules, lacking both explicit reclamation-cost signals and cross-request coordination. We present BidKV, a utility-guided reclamation policy that improves admission responsiveness under KV pressure. Each active request produces a bid encoding recoverable capacity and estimated disruption cost; at each pressure event, an online utility-ranked selection policy identifies the intended highest-utility victim and preempts it via the framework's native mechanism. The current prototype instantiates disruption cost from request-lifecycle proxies (completion progress, prompt length, preemption history) under recompute-fallback semantics. BidKV integrates non-invasively with vLLM and SGLang via a portable adapter layer. Evaluated with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on an NVIDIA RTX A6000 under ShareGPT traces, BidKV reduces P95 TTFT by 89% and improves 300 ms SLO attainment by 14.9 pp over vLLM's native policy, at a modest throughput cost.
abstract_zh: 在线 LLM 服务过程中，当 KV 缓存需求超过 GPU 显存容量时，服务引擎会从活跃请求中回收缓存， 以便接纳等待中的请求。糟糕的牺牲者选择会浪费重算工作、推迟排队请求的准入，并恶化首 token 延迟——这是用户可以直接感知的指标。现有策略依赖粗粒度的请求顺序启发式（LIFO、FCFS）或 独立的单请求打分规则，既缺乏显式的回收代价信号，也缺乏跨请求协调。我们提出 BidKV，一种 效用引导的回收策略，用于改善 KV 压力下的准入响应性。每个活跃请求产生一个投标（bid）， 编码可回收容量与估计的中断代价；在每次压力事件中，在线效用排序选择策略找出预期效用最高的 牺牲者，并通过框架原生机制抢占它。当前原型在重算回退语义下，用请求生命周期代理指标 （完成进度、提示长度、抢占历史）实例化中断代价。BidKV 通过可移植适配层以非侵入方式集成 vLLM 与 SGLang。在 NVIDIA RTX A6000 上使用 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和 ShareGPT 轨迹评估， BidKV 相比 vLLM 原生策略将 P95 TTFT 降低 89%，将 300 ms SLO 达成率提高 14.9 个百分点， 代价是适度的吞吐损失。
summary: 用“投标”把每个请求的回收代价显式化，并在批次层面按效用选择牺牲者；在不改 vLLM/SGLang 源码的前提下显著降低 KV 压力下的 P95 首 token 延迟。
cover_alt: BidKV 论文封面：KV 压力网格、P95 TTFT 631 ms、SLO 83.2% 与 29× 效用

title: TransMLA: Multi-Head Latent Attention Is All You Need
title_zh: TransMLA：多头潜变量注意力足矣
affiliation: Peking University · BIGAI · Tencent Youtu Lab · Xiaomi Corp.
abstract: Modern large-language models often face communication bottlenecks on current hardware rather than computational limitations. Multi-head latent attention (MLA) addresses this by compressing the key-value cache using low-rank matrices, while the Absorb operation prevents the KV cache from reverting to its original size, significantly boosting both training and inference speed. Despite the success of DeepSeek V2/V3/R1, most model providers have heavily invested in optimizing GQA-based models and, therefore, lack strong incentives to retrain MLA-based models from scratch. This paper demonstrates that MLA provides superior expressive power compared to GQA with the same KV cache overhead, thereby offering a rationale for transitioning from GQA to MLA. In addition, we introduce TransMLA, a framework that seamlessly converts any GQA-based pre-trained model (e.g., LLaMA, Qwen, Gemma, Mistral/Mixtral) into an MLA-based model. For the first time, our method enables direct conversion of these models into a format compatible with DeepSeek's codebase, allowing them to fully leverage DeepSeek-specific optimizations such as vLLM and SGLang. By compressing 93% of the KV cache in LLaMA-2-7B, we achieve a 10.6x speedup with an 8K context length while maintaining meaningful output. Moreover, the model requires only 6B tokens for fine-tuning to recover comparable performance across multiple benchmarks. TransMLA provides a practical path for migrating GQA-based models to the MLA structure, and when combined with DeepSeek's advanced optimizations—such as FP8 quantization and Multi-Token Prediction—further inference acceleration can be achieved.
abstract_zh: 现代大语言模型在当前硬件上面对的往往不是计算瓶颈，而是通信瓶颈。多头潜变量注意力（MLA）用低秩 矩阵压缩键值缓存，并通过 Absorb 操作避免 KV 缓存在推理时退回原始大小，从而同时提升训练与推理 速度。尽管 DeepSeek V2/V3/R1 取得了成功，多数模型厂商已在 GQA 模型上投入大量优化，缺乏从零 训练 MLA 模型的动力。本文证明：在相同 KV 缓存开销下，MLA 的表达能力优于 GQA，从而为从 GQA 迁移到 MLA 提供了理论依据。我们还提出 TransMLA，一个能把任意 GQA 预训练模型（如 LLaMA、 Qwen、Gemma、Mistral/Mixtral）无缝转换为 MLA 模型的框架。该方法首次让这些模型可以直接转换为 与 DeepSeek 代码库兼容的格式，从而充分利用 vLLM、SGLang 等 DeepSeek 特定优化。在 LLaMA-2-7B 上压缩 93% 的 KV 缓存后，我们在 8K 上下文下取得 10.6 倍加速，同时保持有意义的输出；只需 6B token 的微调，就能在多个基准上恢复与原模型相当的性能。TransMLA 为 GQA 模型迁移到 MLA 结构 提供了一条实用路径，结合 FP8 量化、多 token 预测等 DeepSeek 高级优化还能进一步加速。
summary: 把 GQA 模型的 KV 头合并、用 RoRoPE/FreqFold 解耦位置信息、再做平衡的低秩压缩，从而低成本 迁移到 MLA，兼容 DeepSeek 推理栈。
cover_alt: GQA、MLA、MQA 的单向等价转换，以及 TransMLA 的 RoRoPE、FreqFold、BKV-PCA 流程

title: DeepSeek-V2: A Strong, Economical, and Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Language Model
title_zh: DeepSeek-V2：强大、经济且高效的混合专家语言模型
abstract: We present DeepSeek-V2, a strong Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model characterized by economical training and efficient inference. It comprises 236B total parameters, of which 21B are activated for each token, and supports a context length of 128K tokens. DeepSeek-V2 adopts innovative architectures including Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) and DeepSeekMoE. MLA guarantees efficient inference through significantly compressing the Key-Value (KV) cache into a latent vector, while DeepSeekMoE enables training strong models at an economical cost through sparse computation. Compared with DeepSeek 67B, DeepSeek-V2 achieves significantly stronger performance, and meanwhile saves 42.5% of training costs, reduces the KV cache by 93.3%, and boosts the maximum generation throughput to 5.76 times. We pretrain DeepSeek-V2 on a high-quality and multi-source corpus consisting of 8.1T tokens, and further perform Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) to fully unlock its potential. Evaluation results show that, even with only 21B activated parameters, DeepSeek-V2 and its chat versions still achieve top-tier performance among open-source models.
abstract_zh: DeepSeek-V2 是一个强大的混合专家（MoE）语言模型，以经济的训练和高效的推理为特征。它总参数量为 236B，每个 token 激活 21B，支持 128K 的上下文长度。DeepSeek-V2 采用多头潜变量注意力（MLA）与 DeepSeekMoE 等创新架构：MLA 通过把键值（KV）缓存显著压缩为潜向量来保证高效推理，DeepSeekMoE 则通过稀疏计算以经济成本训练强模型。与 DeepSeek 67B 相比，DeepSeek-V2 性能显著更强，同时节省 42.5% 的训练成本、将 KV 缓存减少 93.3%，并把最大生成吞吐提升至 5.76 倍。我们在 8.1T token 的 高质量多源语料上预训练 DeepSeek-V2，并通过监督微调（SFT）与强化学习（RL）充分释放其潜力。 评估结果表明，即使只有 21B 激活参数，DeepSeek-V2 及其对话版本仍在开源模型中达到顶级水平。
summary: 用低秩联合压缩把 KV 缓存压成潜向量，并用解耦 RoPE 保持位置信息；MLA 让 236B/21B 的 MoE 模型在 128K 上下文下仍能高效推理。
cover_alt: MHA、GQA、MQA 与 MLA 的 KV 缓存结构对比

title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
title_zh: vLLM：用 PagedAttention 高效管理大模型服务显存
affiliation: UC Berkeley · Stanford University · UC San Diego
venue_full_zh: ACM 操作系统原理研讨会（SOSP）
abstract: High throughput serving of large language models (LLMs) requires batching sufficiently many requests at a time. However, existing systems struggle because the key-value cache (KV cache) memory for each request is huge and grows and shrinks dynamically. When managed inefficiently, this memory can be significantly wasted by fragmentation and redundant duplication, limiting the batch size. To address this problem, we propose PagedAttention, an attention algorithm inspired by the classical virtual memory and paging techniques in operating systems. On top of it, we build vLLM, an LLM serving system that achieves (1) near-zero waste in KV cache memory and (2) flexible sharing of KV cache within and across requests to further reduce memory usage. Our evaluations show that vLLM improves the throughput of popular LLMs by 2-4× with the same level of latency compared to the state-of-the-art systems, such as FasterTransformer and Orca. The improvement is more pronounced with longer sequences, larger models, and more complex decoding algorithms. vLLM's source code is publicly available at https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm.
abstract_zh: 高吞吐地服务大语言模型（LLM）需要一次批处理足够多的请求；但每个请求的键值缓存（KV cache）巨大且动态伸缩，现有系统难以高效管理。管理不当时，显存会被碎片和冗余副本大量浪费，限制批大小。为此，我们提出 PagedAttention——一种受操作系统虚拟内存与分页技术启发的注意力算法。在它之上我们构建了 vLLM 服务系统，做到（1）KV 缓存显存近乎零浪费；（2）请求内与请求间灵活共享 KV 缓存，进一步降低显存占用。评估表明，在相同延迟水平下，vLLM 将主流 LLM 的吞吐相比 FasterTransformer、Orca 等 SOTA 系统提升 2–4 倍；序列更长、模型更大、解码算法更复杂时收益更明显。vLLM 源码已开源：https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm。
summary: 把 KV 缓存切成固定大小的块，用逻辑块表映射到非连续物理显存，并支持写时复制共享；vLLM 以此把 LLM 服务吞吐提升 2–4 倍。
cover_alt: vLLM 封面：分页 KV 缓存与逻辑块表示意

title: Orca: A Distributed Serving System for Transformer-Based Generative Models
title_zh: Orca：面向 Transformer 生成模型的分布式服务系统
venue_full_zh: USENIX 操作系统设计与实现研讨会（OSDI）
abstract: Large-scale Transformer-based models trained for generation tasks (e.g., GPT-3) have recently attracted huge interest, emphasizing the need for system support for serving models in this family. Since these models generate a next token in an autoregressive manner, one has to run the model multiple times to process an inference request where each iteration of the model generates a single output token for the request. However, existing systems for inference serving do not perform well on this type of workload that has a multi-iteration characteristic, due to their inflexible scheduling mechanism that cannot change the current batch of requests being processed; requests that have finished earlier than other requests in a batch cannot return to the client, while newly arrived requests have to wait until the current batch completely finishes. In this paper, we propose iteration-level scheduling, a new scheduling mechanism that schedules execution at the granularity of iteration (instead of request) where the scheduler invokes the execution engine to run only a single iteration of the model on the batch. In addition, to apply batching and iteration-level scheduling to a Transformer model at the same time, we suggest selective batching, which applies batching only to a selected set of operations. Based on these two techniques, we have implemented a distributed serving system called Orca, with additional designs for scalability to models with hundreds of billions of parameters. Our evaluation on a GPT-3 175B model shows that Orca can significantly outperform NVIDIA FasterTransformer in terms of both latency and throughput: 36.9× throughput improvement at the same level of latency.
abstract_zh: 面向生成任务的大规模 Transformer 模型（如 GPT-3）近来备受关注，亟需针对这类模型的服务系统支持。由于这类模型以自回归方式逐 token 生成，处理一个请求需要多次运行模型，每次迭代只生成一个输出 token。现有推理服务系统难以应对这种“多迭代”负载：其调度机制不灵活，无法改变正在处理的批；批内较早完成的请求不能先返回，新到达请求必须等整批结束。本文提出迭代级调度（iteration-level scheduling），以迭代而非请求为粒度调度执行，调度器只让执行引擎在批上运行模型的一次迭代；同时在 Transformer 上把批处理与迭代级调度结合，提出选择性批处理（selective batching），只对选定算子做批处理。基于这两项技术，我们实现分布式服务系统 Orca，并针对数千亿参数模型增加可扩展性设计。在 GPT-3 175B 上的评估表明，Orca 在延迟和吞吐上都显著优于 NVIDIA FasterTransformer：在相同延迟水平下吞吐提升 36.9 倍。
summary: 把 LLM 服务的调度粒度从“请求”降到“一次迭代”，用连续批处理让完成的请求立即返回、新请求随时加入；这是现代 LLM 推理引擎的调度基石。
cover_alt: Orca 封面：迭代级调度与连续批处理时间线

title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
title_zh: FlashAttention：IO 感知的快速省显存精确注意力
affiliation: Stanford University · University at Buffalo, SUNY
venue_full_zh: 神经信息处理系统大会（NeurIPS）
abstract: Transformers are slow and memory-hungry on long sequences, since the time and memory complexity of self-attention are quadratic in sequence length. Approximate attention methods have attempted to address this problem by trading off model quality to reduce the compute complexity, but often do not achieve wall-clock speedup. We argue that a missing principle is making attention algorithms IO-aware—accounting for reads and writes between levels of GPU memory. We propose FlashAttention, an IO-aware exact attention algorithm that uses tiling to reduce the number of memory reads/writes between GPU high bandwidth memory (HBM) and GPU on-chip SRAM. We analyze the IO complexity of FlashAttention, showing that it requires fewer HBM accesses than standard attention, and is optimal for a range of SRAM sizes. We also extend FlashAttention to block-sparse attention, yielding an approximate attention algorithm that is faster than any existing approximate attention method. FlashAttention trains Transformers faster than existing baselines: 15% end-to-end wall-clock speedup on BERT-large (seq. length 512) compared to the MLPerf 1.1 training speed record, 3× speedup on GPT-2 (seq. length 1K), and 2.4× speedup on long-range arena (seq. length 1K-4K). FlashAttention and block-sparse FlashAttention enable longer context in Transformers, yielding higher quality models (0.7 better perplexity on GPT-2 and 6.4 points of lift on long-document classification) and entirely new capabilities: the first Transformers to achieve better-than-chance performance on the Path-X challenge (seq. length 16K, 61.4% accuracy) and Path-256 (seq. length 64K, 63.1% accuracy).
abstract_zh: Transformer 在长序列上又慢又耗显存，因为自注意力的时间和显存复杂度随序列长度平方增长。近似注意力方法试图以牺牲模型质量为代价降低计算复杂度，但往往没有实际墙钟加速。我们认为缺失的原则是让注意力算法具备 IO 感知：显式考虑 GPU 不同层级显存之间的读写。我们提出 FlashAttention，一种 IO 感知的精确注意力算法，用分块（tiling）减少 GPU 高带宽显存（HBM）与片上 SRAM 之间的读写次数。我们分析了 FlashAttention 的 IO 复杂度，证明它比标准注意力需要更少的 HBM 访问，并在一定 SRAM 容量范围内达到最优。我们还将 FlashAttention 扩展到块稀疏注意力，得到比现有近似方法更快的近似注意力算法。FlashAttention 训练 Transformer 更快：在 BERT-large（序列长度 512）上相比 MLPerf 1.1 训练速度纪录取得 15% 端到端加速，GPT-2（1K）上 3 倍，Long Range Arena（1K–4K）上 2.4 倍。FlashAttention 与块稀疏 FlashAttention 让 Transformer 支持更长上下文，带来更高质量（GPT-2 困惑度改善 0.7，长文档分类提升 6.4 分）以及全新能力：首次在 Path-X（16K，61.4% 准确率）和 Path-256（64K，63.1% 准确率）上取得优于随机的性能。
summary: 把注意力计算分块搬进 SRAM、用在线 softmax 避免物化 N×N 矩阵，并在反向时重算；FlashAttention 用 IO 复杂度而非 FLOPs 重新定义了高效注意力。
cover_alt: FlashAttention 封面：HBM/SRAM 分块与注意力 tile 示意

title: RoFormer: Enhanced Transformer with Rotary Position Embedding
title_zh: RoFormer：使用旋转位置嵌入增强的 Transformer
abstract: Position encoding recently has shown effective in the transformer architecture. It enables valuable supervision for dependency modeling between elements at different positions of the sequence. In this paper, we first investigate various methods to integrate positional information into the learning process of transformer-based language models. Then, we propose a novel method named Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) to effectively leverage the positional information. Specifically, the proposed RoPE encodes the absolute position with a rotation matrix and meanwhile incorporates the explicit relative position dependency in self-attention formulation. Notably, RoPE enables valuable properties, including the flexibility of sequence length, decaying inter-token dependency with increasing relative distances, and the capability of equipping the linear self-attention with relative position encoding. Finally, we evaluate the enhanced transformer with rotary position embedding, also called RoFormer, on various long text classification benchmark datasets. Our experiments show that it consistently overcomes its alternatives. Furthermore, we provide a theoretical analysis to explain some experimental results.
abstract_zh: 位置编码近来在 Transformer 架构中展现出有效性，它为序列中不同位置元素之间的依赖建模提供了 有价值的监督信号。本文首先梳理了把位置信息融入 Transformer 语言模型学习过程的各种方法，然后 提出一种新方法——旋转位置嵌入（RoPE），以有效利用位置信息。具体而言，RoPE 用旋转矩阵编码 绝对位置，同时在自注意力公式中显式引入相对位置依赖。值得注意的是，RoPE 具有若干有价值的性质： 序列长度上的灵活性、token 间依赖随相对距离增大而衰减，以及为线性自注意力配备相对位置编码的 能力。最后，我们在多个长文本分类基准上评估了使用旋转位置嵌入增强的 Transformer（RoFormer）。 实验表明，它稳定优于替代方案；我们还提供理论分析来解释部分实验结果。RoFormer 已集成到 Hugging Face Transformers。
summary: 用旋转矩阵把绝对位置写进 query/key，使内积自然只依赖相对距离；RoPE 由此成为现代 LLM 位置编码的事实标准。
cover_alt: RoPE 的二维旋转与多头维度成对旋转示意

title: ZeRO: Memory Optimizations Toward Training Trillion Parameter Models
title_zh: ZeRO：面向万亿参数模型训练的内存优化
venue_full_zh: 国际高性能计算、网络、存储与分析会议（SC）
abstract: Large deep learning models offer significant accuracy gains, but training billions to trillions of parameters is challenging. Existing solutions such as data and model parallelisms exhibit fundamental limitations to fit these models into limited device memory, while obtaining computation, communication and development efficiency. We develop a novel solution, Zero Redundancy Optimizer (ZeRO), to optimize memory, vastly improving training speed while increasing the model size that can be efficiently trained. ZeRO eliminates memory redundancies in data- and model-parallel training while retaining low communication volume and high computational granularity, allowing us to scale the model size proportional to the number of devices with sustained high efficiency. Our analysis on memory requirements and communication volume demonstrates: ZeRO has the potential to scale beyond 1 Trillion parameters using today's hardware. We implement and evaluate ZeRO: it trains large models of over 100B parameter with super-linear speedup on 400 GPUs, achieving throughput of 15 Petaflops. This represents an 8x increase in model size and 10x increase in achievable performance over state-of-the-art. In terms of usability, ZeRO can train large models of up to 13B parameters (e.g., larger than Megatron GPT 8.3B and T5 11B) without requiring model parallelism which is harder for scientists to apply. Last but not the least, researchers have used the system breakthroughs of ZeRO to create the world's largest language model (17B parameters) with record breaking accuracy.
abstract_zh: 大型深度学习模型带来显著精度收益，但训练数十亿到数万亿参数极具挑战。数据并行、模型并行等现有方案在有限显存、计算/通信效率与易用性之间难以兼顾。我们提出 Zero Redundancy Optimizer（ZeRO），通过消除内存冗余来优化显存，在大幅提升训练速度的同时扩大可高效训练的模型规模。ZeRO 在数据并行和模型并行训练中消除内存冗余，同时保留低通信量与高计算粒度，使模型规模可以随设备数近似线性扩展。对显存需求和通信量的分析表明，ZeRO 有潜力在现有硬件上扩展到 1 万亿参数以上。我们在 400 块 GPU 上训练超过 1000 亿参数的模型，取得超线性加速和 15 Petaflops 吞吐，相比当时 SOTA 模型规模扩大 8 倍、可达性能提升 10 倍。ZeRO 还能在不使用模型并行的情况下训练 130 亿参数模型（大于 Megatron GPT 8.3B 和 T5 11B），显著降低科学家的使用门槛；研究者还借助 ZeRO 的系统突破训练出当时世界最大的 170 亿参数语言模型并刷新精度纪录。
summary: 把优化器状态、梯度和参数按数据并行进程分片，消除冗余显存；ZeRO 让纯数据并行也能训练百亿甚至万亿参数模型。
cover_alt: ZeRO 封面：优化器状态、梯度与参数分片的内存条示意

title: Megatron-LM: Training Multi-Billion Parameter Language Models Using Model Parallelism
title_zh: Megatron-LM：用模型并行训练数十亿参数语言模型
abstract: Recent work in language modeling demonstrates that training large transformer models advances the state of the art in Natural Language Processing (NLP) applications. However, very large models can be quite difficult to train due to memory constraints. In this work, we present our techniques for training very large transformer models and implement a simple, efficient intra-layer model parallel approach that enables training transformer models with billions of parameters. Our approach does not require a new compiler or library changes, is orthogonal and complimentary to pipeline model parallelism, and can be fully implemented with the insertion of a few communication operations in native PyTorch. We illustrate this approach by converging transformer based models up to 8.3 billion parameters using 512 GPUs. We sustain 15.1 PetaFLOPs across the entire application with 76% scaling efficiency when compared to a strong single GPU baseline that sustains 39 TeraFLOPs, which is 30% of peak FLOPs. To demonstrate that large language models can further advance the state of the art (SOTA), we train an 8.3 billion parameter transformer language model similar to GPT-2 and a 3.9 billion parameter model similar to BERT. We show that careful attention to the placement of layer normalization in BERT-like models is critical to achieving increased performance as the model size grows. Using the GPT-2 model we achieve SOTA results on the WikiText103 (10.8 compared to SOTA perplexity of 15.8) and LAMBADA (66.5% compared to SOTA accuracy of 63.2%) datasets. Our BERT model achieves SOTA results on the RACE dataset (90.9% compared to SOTA accuracy of 89.4%).
abstract_zh: 近期语言模型研究表明，训练更大的 Transformer 能推进 NLP 应用的最优结果，但超大模型受显存约束，训练十分困难。本文给出训练超大规模 Transformer 的技术，并实现一种简单高效的层内模型并行方法，使 Transformer 可以训练到数十亿参数。该方法不需要新编译器或改库，与流水线模型并行正交且互补，只需在原生 PyTorch 中插入少量通信操作即可完整实现。我们用 512 块 GPU 将 Transformer 收敛到 83 亿参数，整个应用持续达到 15.1 PetaFLOPs，相比单 GPU 强基线（39 TeraFLOPs，约为峰值算力的 30%）取得 76% 的扩展效率。为证明大模型能继续推进 SOTA，我们训练了类似 GPT-2 的 83 亿参数模型和类似 BERT 的 39 亿参数模型；结果表明，类 BERT 模型中 LayerNorm 的放置位置对规模增大后的性能至关重要。GPT-2 模型在 WikiText103（困惑度 10.8，此前 SOTA 15.8）和 LAMBADA（准确率 66.5%，此前 SOTA 63.2%）上取得 SOTA；BERT 模型在 RACE 上取得 90.9%（此前 SOTA 89.4%）。
summary: 把 Transformer 层内的矩阵乘法按列/行切到多张 GPU 上，只用少量 all-reduce 就实现 8 路张量并行；这是大模型训练系统的奠基工作。

title: Attention Is All You Need
title_zh: Attention Is All You Need：Transformer 架构
affiliation: Google Brain · Google Research · University of Toronto
venue_full_zh: 神经信息处理系统大会（NeurIPS）
abstract: The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks that include an encoder and a decoder. The best performing models also connect the encoder and decoder through an attention mechanism. We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely. Experiments on two machine translation tasks show these models to be superior in quality while being more parallelizable and requiring significantly less time to train. Our model achieves 28.4 BLEU on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task, improving over the existing best results, including ensembles, by over 2 BLEU. On the WMT 2014 English-to-French translation task, our model establishes a new single-model state-of-the-art BLEU score of 41.8 after training for 3.5 days on eight GPUs, a small fraction of the training costs of the best models from the literature. We show that the Transformer generalizes well to other tasks by applying it successfully to English constituency parsing both with large and limited training data.
abstract_zh: 主流的序列转导模型基于复杂的循环或卷积神经网络，包含编码器与解码器；性能最好的模型还会用注意力机制连接编码器和解码器。我们提出一种新的简单网络架构 Transformer，它完全基于注意力机制，彻底舍弃循环和卷积。两个机器翻译任务上的实验表明，这类模型质量更优、更易并行化，训练时间也显著缩短。在 WMT 2014 英德翻译任务上，我们的模型取得 28.4 BLEU，超过此前最佳结果（包括集成模型）2 BLEU 以上；在 WMT 2014 英法任务上，模型在 8 块 GPU 上训练 3.5 天后取得 41.8 BLEU 的单模型新 SOTA，训练成本仅为文献中最佳模型的一小部分。我们还将 Transformer 成功应用于英语成分句法分析（包括大规模和有限训练数据），说明它可以泛化到其他任务。
summary: 用纯注意力替换循环与卷积，把序列建模变成可大规模并行的矩阵运算；Transformer 由此成为现代 LLM 的底座。
cover_alt: Transformer 封面：多头注意力与编码器/解码器堆叠示意
